note: Contract invariants are C-NN; the Roost round has R-NN; phase documents define their own I-NN-X. A bare I-NN means the whole phase family listed under families.

invariants.statement: While no settlement is in flight, the sum of the members' escrows equals the group's total escrow.
invariants.plain: The books balance: the group's total is exactly what its members hold.

invariants.statement: Within a release window, the total released never exceeds the cap times the window's base escrow.
invariants.plain: However often a room signs, it can only drain a fixed share per window.

invariants.statement: A settlement pays only recipients on the group's allowed list.
invariants.plain: Money can only go where the public rules say.

invariants.statement: A settlement needs a valid signature over the exact message: contract, group, epoch, nonce, allocation hash, (charges hash), order hash. A signature for one kind of settlement cannot authorise another.
invariants.plain: A signature means exactly one thing.

invariants.statement: A round nonce works once: after a settlement finishes the nonce changes, and the old signature is dead.
invariants.plain: A signed payout cannot be replayed.

invariants.statement: At most one settlement is in flight per group, and a pending record exists exactly while one is.
invariants.plain: Only one payout at a time, and the contract always knows what it still owes.

invariants.statement: Once the timer or deadline has passed and nothing is in flight, a member can take their own escrow out, whatever the release policy says.
invariants.plain: Every member has a solo exit.

invariants.statement: An exit lowers the group's total and the release-cap base together.
invariants.plain: Money that has left stops counting toward what may be released.

invariants.statement: The policy hash a depositor names covers the recipients, the cap, the deadline and the exit timer; a deposit that misstates any of them is refused.
invariants.plain: You can only deposit into rules you agreed to, including how long the exit takes.

invariants.statement: A member is listed once, and the active count never exceeds 50.
invariants.plain: Nobody is counted twice, so quorum and capacity mean what they say.

invariants.statement: In a charged settlement each charge is at most that member's escrow and the charges sum to exactly the payout.
invariants.plain: Nobody pays more than they hold, and what is paid out is what was charged.

invariants.statement: A group's status only moves forward: Active to Settled or AbortedRefunded; those two stay.
invariants.plain: A finished group cannot be reopened.

invariants.statement: Only registered member accounts may deposit into syndicate escrow.
invariants.plain: Old rule from phase 07. The contract has no member registry: any account may deposit if it names the current policy hash.

invariants.statement: A Roost round produces at most one signed settlement: once an aggregate is signed, no run* may replace it until a new round is opened.
invariants.plain: The host signs once per round, so there are never two valid signed payouts for the same epoch and nonce.
